mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.user_photo AS userPhoto, NULL AS replyToNickName, CASE WHEN c.status = 1 THEN '[评论已删除]' ELSE c.content END AS content, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_comment r WHERE r.parent_comment_id = c.id AND r.status = 0) AS replyCount, CASE WHEN c.status = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS deleted, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime FROM book_comment c JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.book_id = #{bookId} AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_comment c WHERE c.book_id = #{bookId} AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL

SELECT c.id AS id, c.user_id AS userId, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.user_photo AS userPhoto, p_user.nick_name AS replyToNickName, c.content AS content, 0 AS replyCount, FALSE AS deleted, c.create_time AS createTime, c.update_time AS updateTime FROM book_comment c JOIN book_comment p ON p.id = c.parent_comment_id AND p.book_id = #{bookId} AND p.parent_comment_id IS NULL JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id JOIN sys_user p_user ON p_user.id = p.user_id WHERE c.book_id = #{bookId} AND c.parent_comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.status = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_comment ( book_id, user_id, parent_comment_id, content, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{bookId}, #{userId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{content}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
